title: Tasty Ground Turkey Tacos
description: This tasty ground turkey taco recipe, made with tomato sauce, taco seasoning, and green chiles, can be topped with lettuce, Cheddar, or other toppings.
ingredients: 1 (4 ounce) can diced green chile peppers
1 cup shredded lettuce, or to taste
0.5 cup Cheddar cheese, or to taste
0.5 cup diced tomatoes, or to taste
0.25 cup chopped green onion, or to taste
0.25 cup chopped cilantro, or to taste
2 tablespoons sliced olives, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add turkey; cook and stir until browned, about 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce, water, green chiles, onion, taco seasoning, and garlic; simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 30 minutes.
Serve turkey mixture in tortillas. Top with lettuce, Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, green onion, cilantro, and sliced olives.

video.description: Change up your favorite beef tacos by replacing ground beef with ground turkey for dinner that’s less greasy and better for you. To the cooked turkey add tomato sauce, water, green chile peppers, onion, taco seasoning and garlic. After a good simmering, spoon into tortillas and top with lettuce, Cheddar cheese, fresh tomatoes, green onion, cilantro and black olives. Keep some low fat sour cream or yogurt around, along with some hot sauce for a perfectly customizable taco feast.
video.name: Tasty Ground Turkey Tacos
